fixes_in_this_run.P0 scripts/ci/full-acceptance.sh subset: With TOGAVSU_ACCEPTANCE_IDS set, the script passes it as --ids to scripts/release/full_acceptance.py. The runner then runs the checks of exactly the listed criteria, decides no release gate, and exits 0 only when every listed criterion passes on a clean tree. An empty list or an unknown id exits 2 before any check runs. Unset, the script runs all 52 criteria and every gate as before. The old --phase selector, built on the 52-criterion phase map, is removed. Regression tests in tests/test_full_acceptance.py run the real script and runner in a throwaway git repo with synthetic checks. They cover: exact subset and pass, a failing criterion, a check printing PENDING, a criterion with a gap, empty and unknown ids, unset running every criterion and gate, and a dirty tree.
fixes_in_this_run.P0 docs/build/reports/release.json: Rewritten by scripts/release/write_report.py from one subset run per phase case in the assignment's phase_acceptance map: candidate-acceptance (48), signed-images-updater-load (AC-013, AC-016) and backup-restore (AC-018, AC-040). Each exited 0 with status pass at tested_revision. The passed and pending ids partition only the 48 assigned. The writer refuses non-subset runs, runs that don't match the mapped ids, dirty-tree runs and mixed revisions (tested).

earlier_work_kept_on_this_branch: Ledger superuser exposure (PRD 6, AC-006, AC-024): bootstrap writes admin_database_url only to the new adminsecrets volume (mounted by bootstrap, migrate and the supervisor) and the backup passphrase to the new backupkey volume; the core mounts appsecrets read-only; supervisor.CoreBinds gives replacement cores the same mounts and only the update migrator gets the superuser volume (MigrateBinds). Earlier layouts are moved on the next bootstrap (test-bootstrap.sh).

core migrate fails closed: core.MigrateSealed returns ErrNoAdminDatabaseURL without the superuser URL, and after sealing checks with db.VerifySealed, on the application role's own connection, that schema core and every append-only table are owned by togavsu_ledger_owner and cannot be altered, updated, deleted or truncated. The entrypoint exits 2 for migrate without /adminsecrets/admin_database_url.

The serving core refuses an unsealed database (core.Config.RequireSealed, set by cmd/core) and refuses to start when it can see the superuser URL (entrypoint: a mounted file; cmd/core: the environment value).
A supervisor restore runs the same seal script (internal/ledgerseal) on the loaded copy before the swap, so a core restarted on restored data starts sealed (TestRestoreSealsLedgers).

Regression tests: TestLedgersSealedForApplicationRole (migrate without the URL, Open refusing an unsealed and a tampered database, ownership re-sealed), TestMigrateFailsWithoutSuperuserURL, TestServeRefusesSuperuserURL, TestCoreAndMigratorSecretMounts, TestRestoreSealsLedgers, scripts/ci/test-bootstrap.sh (entrypoint cases), scripts/ci/check-compose.py (mount rules), scripts/ci/test-compose-first-run.sh (no superuser URL in the running core, read-only appsecrets, migrate failing without the URL, the core refusing an unsealed database).

Release signing (decided 2026-11-12): deploy/release/cosign.pub committed and copied into the supervisor image at /usr/share/togavsu/cosign.pub; compose.yaml COSIGN_KEY points there and COSIGN_VERIFY_FLAGS defaults to --insecure-ignore-tlog=true; tests/update/load.sh mounts a throwaway key in its place and checks the image ships the release key.

docs/release/proposed-ci/release.yml (actionlint clean): publish builds and pushes both images and records digests in the job summary and digests.json; attach-signature runs scripts/release/attach-signature.sh, which refuses an unrecorded digest, a payload naming another digest and a signature the release key did not make, then runs cosign attach signature with GITHUB_TOKEN. scripts/ci/test-release-attach.sh tests every refusal and the good path with throwaway keys.

Supervisor suite flake: the full acceptance run at 25d6b2c failed supervisor-suite (and so AC-016) on TestStalledPathRestoreRestartsWriters, which returned while a path worker was still writing into its TempDir. It and TestStalledPathPutReleasesTheGateAndKeepsPendingOwnership now wait until no tracked operation on the destination is running, and the Put test restores the normal I/O budget before its reconcile; 32 of 32 runs pass with four concurrent -race copies.

verify-release.sh, docs/release/README.md, INSTALL.md and the evidence map describe the decision: no repository secret, the public key in the repository and image, signing off GitHub without the public log.
